name: gizmo-process-library
description: Repository-local procedures for programming and translating Gizmo XML Web Components with AI agents.

procedures.purpose: Create one Web Component from one XML source.
Full process for converting existing JavaScript Web Components into Gizmo XML.
Concise checklist for converting imperative components.
Extract tag, props, methods, events, and public guarantees.
Translate constructor fields, accessors, arrays, choices, JSON attributes, and normalization.
Translate createElement/append/class/style/dataset/repeated DOM into view markup.
Translate listeners, CustomEvent emission, actions, stop/prevent, and event details.
Translate pointer, drag, pan, zoom, key, resize, and connect behaviors.
Translate observers, frames, timers, measurement, cleanup, and external effects.
Translate SVG, path generation, transforms, coordinate spaces, and layout probes.
Detect and remove hidden imperative implementations.
Keep card, cable, and graph as separate Web Components.
Add semantic runtime/layout diagnostics.
Compile declarative XML into standalone dist output and verify quality gates.
Add or update procedures when the project learns a new rule.
Use the canonical contract/requires/model/view/behavior/effects/resources/dev component capsule.
Translate imports, globals, browser APIs, services, assets, and host powers into requires/provides.
Choose action, event, reducer, stream, machine, command, or luxury interaction without ideological confusion.
Separate effects from acquired resources and prevent lifecycle bugs.
Keep features.json, compiler features, and process-library search routes synchronized.
